title: Unit 2: Time and daily routines
title_vi: Thời gian và các hoạt động hằng ngày
description: Tell the time and ask when people do daily activities.

vocabulary.example: I get up at six o’clock.
I have breakfast at six thirty.
I go to school at seven o’clock.
I go to bed at nine thirty.
I have lunch at eleven thirty.
I have dinner at seven o’clock.
I do my homework in the evening.

questions.passage: My name is Linh and this is my Mom and my Dad. Every day, in the morning, I get up at six o’clock. My mom and dad get up at 5.30. I have breakfast with my family at 6 then I go to school at 7 o’clock. My mom goes to work at 7.15. My Dad goes to work at 7.15, too. I go to school by bike. My mom and dad go to work by motorbike. I go home at 5 o’clock. My mom goes home at 5.30 and cooks dinner. We have dinner at 6.30 p.m. I go to bed at 9.30. My parents go to bed at 10.30.
